title: Flip failure tests rely on a fixed settle delay
summary: fail_flip_during_step slept 0.5 s before failing the flip, so the flip could fail during an earlier step and the timer-cancel assertion would pass without a running wait step. Next: wait for the running wait step or the busy imager.

resolution.evidence: Tests wait for 'Suspended for 10s' or the busy imager before failing the flip; suite 44/44 three times; verification.md.
